pyqgis_plugin.name: TKAP Tools
pyqgis_plugin.description: Field tools for the Türkmen-Karahöyük Archaeological Project: stratigraphic phasing, section drawing, and Emlid GNSS point conversion.
pyqgis_plugin.about:
The TKAP QGIS toolset, shipped as one plugin so the tools stay in step with the project's Stratigraphic Unit schema. Three tools live under the TKAP Tools menu:
Stratigraphic Phasing -- splits a layer of Stratigraphic Units into one layer per phase for a chosen excavation field, parsing the delimited space_phase attribute. An SU spanning several phases is written into every phase layer it belongs to. Output goes to live filtered layers, scratch layers, or a GeoPackage. A second action exports one phase plan per layer from a print layout you designed.
Section Drawing -- draw a section trace in plan view, pick the SUs that cross it, place a photo of the excavation wall using surveyed control points, and digitise SU polygons against absolute elevation. Outputs a measured drawing and a wireframe-over-photo version, both with an elevation axis. Newer than the other two tools; treat as beta.
Emlid to SU -- reads Emlid GNSS point exports and connects each SU's points in increment order into a closed polygon, either replacing geometry on an existing SU layer or building onto a new temporary layer.
